mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, t.name AS name, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS article_count FROM tag t LEFT JOIN article_tag at ON at.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN article a ON a.id = at.article_id AND a.status = 'published' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.is_common = 1 GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY article_count DESC, t.name ASC
